data.title: 小岭幸 · 润物细雨的花圃静候
data.description: 【小岭幸 · 润物细雨的花圃静候】美浜学园中庭盛开着各色绣球花的花圃小径旁，天空飘洒着细密的初夏微雨。幸双手握着一把小巧的绿色浇水壶，伫立在湿润的花丛中央。细雨在她的白色女仆围裙与蕾丝发箍上凝成一颗颗晶莹剔透的水珠。她转过身，向着撑伞走来的雄二露出无比温柔清澈的微笑，宛如雨后初霁的一抹纯净白莲。
data.location: 学园中庭绣球花与石子路花圃
data.action: 双手握浇水壶在花丛中回眸微笑，细雨沾湿发丝与围裙，眼神纯真澄澈
data.lighting: 雨天均匀柔和的冷白天光与花瓣水珠上的晶莹反光
data.camera: cowboy shot, medium framing, beautiful floral depth of field
data.promptProse: Komine Sachi turns among rain-wet hydrangeas, holding a small green watering can in both hands and smiling toward Yuuji approaching with an umbrella. Her lace headdress and white apron collect droplets. The cowboy composition follows the courtyard path between flowering beds toward the academy wall. Overcast morning light spreads evenly across pink braids and flower heads, with soft contact shadows under leaves and clear highlights on water beads.
